items.title: AgensGraph 2.18 Released: Graph Database on PostgreSQL 18 with Expanded ISO GQL Support
items.summary: The AgensGraph Development Team is pleased to announce the release of AgensGraph v2.18.6.1, the latest version in the 2.18 series. AgensGraph is an open-source graph database, built on PostgreSQL 18.6, that runs SQL and graph queries over the same data, in the same transaction and even in the same statement.

items.title: HeapDeck: an on-call monitor for PostgreSQL on iPhone and iPad
items.summary: HeapDeck is a new native app for engineers on call for PostgreSQL 13 to 19, on the App Store for iPhone and iPad. It opens on one health verdict with ten tiles. The Locks screen draws the tree from pg_blocking_pids() with the root blocker on top and counts the sessions that stopping it would free.
